name: Mean nucleotide residue mass (modified RNA)
scale_system: general — 2'-OMe/2'-F/PS modified RNA, approximate
notes: Order-of-magnitude from standard ribonucleotide monophosphate residue masses (~305-345 Da); PS and 2' mods shift this. Used only for MW scale, not spec.

name: Single-strand molecular weight
scale_system: our product — 21-mer modified strand
notes: ~7 kDa = 21 x ~330. Arithmetic estimate pending confirmed sequence/mod pattern.

name: Duplex molecular weight
scale_system: our product — 21/23-mer duplex
notes: ~14 kDa arithmetic. Note SEC-MALS measured 17.15 kDa on a specific siRNA (SRC-ZYDNEY-2024).

name: Mass difference full-length vs n-1
scale_system: our product — single nucleotide deletion
notes: One residue (~330 Da) out of ~7000 Da strand = ~4.7%. Below any UF size-separation threshold.

name: Latent heat of vaporisation of water (approx 40-60 C vacuum)
scale_system: physical constant — water at reduced pressure
notes: ~2400 kJ/kg near 40-60 C; 2257 kJ/kg at 100 C. Standard steam-table value.

name: Ligation conversion
scale_system: measured — immobilised RNA ligase, fully modified siRNA blocks, 5 mL packed column, 600 uM
notes: PER-LIGATION conversion, NOT a step mass yield and NOT the overall mass yield (see P-YLD-LIG, P-YIELD-OVERALL-PUB). Measured >92% single-feed and >94% split-feed on fully modified siRNA blocks in continuous flow, held >100 h (SRC-CN119265174). The often-quoted 82-96% range is a ligase screen on an UNMODIFIED shortmer whose phosphorothioate donors reacted only ~30% (SRC-NATCOMM-2024); >95% is an unreviewed vendor claim traceable only to a marketing blog (SRC-CODEXIS, SRC-CODEXIS-PR-2024, SRC-CODEXIS-PATENTS). Our kg-scale value is open. See Q-010.

name: Block full-length purity
scale_system: measured — 4-5 nt MOE/DNA gapmer blocks, 145-258 g, 5'-DMTr (NOT our 5'-phosphate 2'-OMe/2'-F/PS blocks)
notes: BAND: measured chromatography-free full-length purity 89-96% for 4-5 nt modified blocks at 145-258 g (SRC-WO2020227618); point value 92% used by purity_floor(). CHEMISTRY CAVEAT: those are MOE/DNA gapmer blocks carrying a 5'-DMTr purity handle a 5'-phosphate block lacks, not our 2'-OMe/2'-F/PS blocks; 81% was measured for a 6-mer 2'-OMe PS (SRC-KELLY-OPRD-2025), so 95%-class blocks are not assured in our chemistry. The multiplicative floor model is independently validated: an 18-mer assembled from four blocks read 80% at 200 g, implying ~94.6% per block (SRC-NAR-2025), and a 1-3% per-cycle failure rate gives 89-96% for a 5-mer (SRC-US6087491). See Q-011 and the filtration finding.

name: Step yield: ligation + workup
scale_system: ASSUMPTION — placeholder
notes: Flagged assumption for the balance: ligation + workup STEP mass yield. Distinct from PER-LIGATION conversion (P-LIG-CONV, >92%) and from published OVERALL campaign mass yield of 19-43% (P-YIELD-OVERALL-PUB, SRC-HONGENE-BROCHURE-2025). A balance that reads a >92% per-ligation conversion as a step yield overstates output several-fold. See Q-012.

name: UF/DF product retention coefficient (membrane passage)
scale_system: single-strand antisense oligo on 3 kDa membrane (NOT an siRNA duplex); sieving <0.008
notes: Product retention R feeding the diafiltration loss relation (EQ-UFYIELD). Anchored to a sieving coefficient <0.008 (R>0.992) reported for a single-strand antisense oligonucleotide on a 3 kDa membrane (SRC-GRONKE-2023) - a different molecular form from our duplex, read from the abstract only. See Q-036.

name: UF/DF unrecoverable hold-up loss (additive)
scale_system: mRNA at 20-80 mL TFF (a larger molecule; the hold-up mechanism transfers, the fraction is scale-dependent)
notes: Additive product loss to unrecoverable hold-up in tubing and filters, the term the old flat P-YLD-UFDF lacked. 30-40% was measured for mRNA at 20-80 mL (SRC-NOURAFKAN-2024); it dominates at small batch size and does not scale down cleanly, so the 0.10 placeholder is a plant-scale guess, not a transferable constant. See Q-036, R-011.

name: UF/DF membrane adsorption loss (additive)
scale_system: protein UF/DF (adsorption figures are protein-specific, not oligonucleotide)
notes: Additive membrane-adsorption loss, tabulated at 0.02-0.10 (low) to 1.0-5.0 (high) for proteins depending on membrane material (SRC-MILLIPORE-TFF) - a protein-specific figure, no oligonucleotide value exists. See Q-036.

name: Step yield: evaporation
scale_system: ASSUMPTION — placeholder
notes: Flagged assumption. See Q-012.

name: Step yield: spray drying (of dryer feed solids)
scale_system: sticky small molecule, 5-400 g (yield BEHAVIOUR transfers; the material does not - not a nucleic acid)
notes: BAND: measured spray-dryer recoveries run 8.6-22% unoptimised and 61-89% optimised across 5-400 g (SRC-KAPIL-2025). Point value 75% is a representative OPTIMISED figure; range 61-89% is the optimised band. Optimised conditions transferred between scales, unoptimised ones did not, so the honest first-campaign starting assumption is the unoptimised 8.6-22%. Material is a sticky small molecule, not a nucleic acid. See Q-012.

name: Overall mass yield, published ligation-built siRNA campaigns
scale_system: vendor GMP campaigns, ~1 kg batches; 2'-OMe/2'-F PS/PO siRNA
notes: BAND (vendor-published): overall mass yields of 19-43% for kilogram-scale ligation-built siRNA (Inclisiran P-to-P 26%, Divalent P-to-P 19%, C-to-P 43%; SRC-HONGENE-BROCHURE-2025). No single point value is representative and none is asserted; the earlier 31 was an unsourced midpoint and has been removed. YIELD DEFINITION travels with the number: unoptimised, based on theoretical MEC, calculated from the lowest-yielding fragment. Documentation reality-check on the balance's step-yield product, NOT a balance input; the two use different definitions. Compare Q-012.

name: Ligation reactor product concentration
scale_system: demonstrated ~1 mM titre of a ~14-15 kDa duplex at 1 L scale (SRC-ALMAC-2023); not our kg-scale duplex
notes: Flagged assumption. Anchored to the only demonstrated enzymatic-ligation titre: ~1 mM in jacketed 1 L vessels (SRC-ALMAC-2023), which for a ~14-15 kDa duplex is ~14-16 g/L (arithmetic ours); 15 g/L used. The vendor "up to 100 g/L" is a substrate LOAD, not a product titre, and the previously carried "30 g/L titre" is NOT in SRC-CODEXIS (see its register note and Q-034). See Q-016.

name: UF max achievable concentration
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - siRNA basis; charged membrane raised achievable concentration from 52 to >180 mg/mL (bench)
notes: Flagged assumption, on an siRNA (not total solids) basis to match the cited literature. Charged membranes raised achievable siRNA concentration from 52 to >180 mg/mL (SRC-ZYDNEY-2024) and to ~193 g/L in the ligand-density follow-up (SRC-ZYDNEY-2025, abstract); 200 mg/mL at >=95% yield and <15 cP was reached for a single-strand antisense oligo (SRC-GRONKE-2023). Viscosity is NOT what stops it. 150 g/L kept as a conservative placeholder. Decides whether evaporation is needed. See Q-017.

name: Evaporator outlet concentration (total dissolved solids)
scale_system: ASSUMPTION, TOTAL SOLIDS basis; anchor is single-strand ASO solution (NOT an siRNA duplex, NOT a dryer feed)
notes: Flagged assumption on a TOTAL dissolved solids basis. Anchored to the maximum 160 mg ASO/g solution achieved in manufacture by thin-film evaporation (SRC-PMC7415879) - a single-strand antisense oligonucleotide, a different molecular form from our duplex, and an API-basis number carried onto our total-solids basis. TRAP: that paper's 'few hours' is a batch cycle time, NOT a fluid residence time - do not cite it as one. See Q-018 and the balance method page.

name: Spray-dryer feed solids
scale_system: ASSUMPTION — placeholder
notes: Flagged assumption; sets dryer water load. See Q-019.

name: Diafiltration diavolumes for buffer exchange
scale_system: general diafiltration theory (molecule-independent); confirmed on a nucleic-acid process at 4-6 DV
notes: Flagged assumption. Diafiltration clearance is molecule-independent theory (EQ-DIAF): the vendor diavolume table reproduces the site's removal percentages exactly (SRC-PALL-TFF; 5 DV=99.3%, 7 DV=99.9%) and the same relation the protein/mAb literature uses (SRC-BPT-TFF) applies unchanged to a nucleic acid, documented at 4-6 diavolumes (SRC-HUSSON-CIRCRNA-2025). See Q-020.

name: Excipient : API mass ratio (spray dry)
scale_system: ASSUMPTION — placeholder (trehalose matrix)
notes: Flagged assumption (trehalose matrix). Reframed by F-024: the excipient is a DRYING and POWDER-PROPERTY aid, not a chemical stabiliser - approved siRNA products are stable at 160-200 mg/mL in near-pure water and four of seven carry no weighed excipient (SRC-SIRNA-LABELS). So the ratio is set by what the DRYER needs, not the molecule; no dried siRNA product has ever been approved, so no ratio transfers. See Q-021.

name: Fraction of excipient load already in solution at the evaporator
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - base case adds bulk excipient after evaporation
notes: 0 = all excipient added after evaporation (base case); 1 = full load present at the final DF. Risk R-005 requires salts exchanged OUT at final DF but not the excipient load IN. Setting this to 1 with the current concentration placeholders leaves evaporation with almost no duty. See Q-038, Q-021.

name: Minimum wetting rate - falling-film evaporator (water)
scale_system: water on vertical stainless steel; NOT a polyelectrolyte solution, so surface tension and contact angle dominate and the transfer to our matrix is plausible but unproven
notes: BAND: reported minimum wetting rate 0.10-0.22 kg/m/s for water on vertical steel (SRC-HUGHES-2024). Sets evaporator turndown (R-013, R-004): below it the film breaks into rivulets and dry patches foul, so a small batch must recirculate rather than run single-pass. Water, not our matrix; the transfer is plausible but unproven. See Q-018.

name: Specific heat of the process solution
scale_system: dilute aqueous stream approximated as water
notes: Dilute aqueous solution approximated as water (4.18 kJ/kg/K, the cited steam-table value); drives the evaporator sensible-heat term. Our concentrated polyelectrolyte matrix will differ slightly. See Q-045.

name: Specific heat of the drying gas
scale_system: air or nitrogen at drying temperatures (standard value)
notes: Standard specific heat of air/N2 near drying temperatures (~1.0 kJ/kg/K); drives the derived drying-gas mass and the heater duty. NO PRIMARY SOURCE IS REGISTERED for this constant, which is why it is flagged inference rather than fact - it is a standard textbook value, not our reasoning, and registering a primary gas-properties source is an open action. Air is ~1.005-1.01 and N2 ~1.04, so 'air or nitrogen' is not a single value. See Q-046.

name: Evaporator feed temperature
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - placeholder (near-ambient feed)
notes: Temperature of the retentate entering the evaporator; sensible heat raises it to the vacuum boiling point. Placeholder pending the thermal operating point. See Q-045.

name: Evaporator boiling temperature under vacuum
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - vacuum operating point chosen to protect the duplex
notes: BAND: vacuum boiling point held low (40-60 C) so the duplex is never heated near its Tm; 50 C is the representative point. Boiling-point elevation rises as solutes concentrate (EQ-EVAP, EQ-BPE). See Q-045.

name: Spray-dryer inlet gas temperature
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - placeholder
notes: Drying-gas inlet temperature. While the droplet is wet the particle sits near the wet-bulb temperature, far below the inlet gas (spray-drying finding), so a hot inlet does not heat the product to inlet temperature. Placeholder pending the drying design. See Q-046.

name: Spray-dryer outlet gas temperature
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - held below the duplex Tm
notes: Outlet gas temperature held below the duplex melting temperature (Tm 58-64 C, Q-030) and used as a conservative proxy for the product; the powder must also stay below its moisture-shifted Tg (Q-039). Placeholder. See Q-046.

name: Thermal loss fraction (evaporator and dryer)
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - placeholder (heat loss to surroundings)
notes: Fraction added ONCE to the evaporator and dryer PROCESS duties for heat loss to surroundings; 5% placeholder pending the thermal design. It is not applied to the gas enthalpy drop, which already contains wall losses. See Q-045.

name: Drying-gas ambient temperature before the inlet heater
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - placeholder (near-ambient intake air)
notes: Temperature of the drying gas BEFORE the inlet heater. This is what makes the heater duty computable: UT-DRYGAS is inlet air/N2 heating, so the utility load is the gas mass times cp times (inlet - ambient), not the enthalpy drop across the dryer. Placeholder pending the drying design. See Q-046.

name: Process solution density (evaporator feed basis)
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - dilute aqueous approximated as water; a 150 g/L polyelectrolyte retentate runs nearer 1.05-1.08 kg/L
notes: Density converting the evaporator feed VOLUME into the MASS the sensible-heat term needs. Until now this conversion was implicit - litres were used directly as kilograms - so an unregistered number was entering the balance where no provenance guard could see it. The approximation is weakest exactly where it is applied, at the concentrated retentate. Placeholder. See Q-045.

name: Health-based exposure limit (HBEL/PDE) for cleaning validation
scale_system: ASSUMPTION - requires toxicology/PDE data that does not exist publicly for this molecule
notes: Value deliberately BLANK: no PDE/HBEL can be derived without toxicology data, which does not exist in the public record for this molecule, so it is registered as a gap rather than invented. The DERIVATION METHOD (PDE then MACO / limit per swab or rinse) is documented on the microbial page (SRC-WHO-TRS1044). Needed for cleaning validation of the shared, hard-to-clean evaporator and dryer (R-008, R-015). See Q-047.
